title: CDN Edge Caching — Companion Code
description: Multi-provider CDN caching configuration: Cloudflare cache rules via the Ruleset API, an AWS CloudFront Terraform module with a minimal cache key, Fastly VCL with surrogate keys, and purge scripts for all three.
description_es: Configuración de caché CDN multi-proveedor: cache rules de Cloudflare vía la Ruleset API, un módulo Terraform de AWS CloudFront con clave de caché mínima, VCL de Fastly con surrogate keys y scripts de purga para los tres.
